OUR MISSION STATEMENT
WELCOME TO TURNERS
Over 90 years on and Turners has grown to be one of the largest and most successful privately owned Transport companies in the United Kingdom operating in excess of 1850 vehicles from 32 sites and employing over 3400 people.
Specialists operations include:
Temperature controlled transport and bulk storage.
Bulk building powder products.
Food products both liquid and dry
Fruit produce picking, packing, storage and distribution.
Frozen and chilled storage and added value services.
Turners' enviable reputation for providing professional and innovative supply chain solutions is based on extensive technical and logistics experience and knowledge in operating a fleet that travels throughout the United Kingdom and mainland Europe.
Turners are pleased to present an extensive portfolio of quality services and solutions to exceed the ever increasing demands within the Transport, Bulk Storage and Logistics industry sectors.

OUR MISSION STATEMENT
Turners are an independent, privately owned company employing in excess of 2000 colleagues who are recognised as a key ingredient to the business success and growth. Experienced, proactive management and staff are responsible for operating over 1000 vehicles and 1400 trailers from 32 locations.
The head office site at Newmarket extends to 40 acres, which includes 500,000 sq ft of temperature controlled storage for 80,000 pallets, a division of the refrigerated transport fleet and PPL, our processing and packing operations. Phase 6 of our site development was completed in November 2009.
Our business is about delivering cost efficient, innovative, Supply Chain Solutions for transport and warehousing. Sustained and consistent growth has enabled continued investment in people, technology and equipment to ensure maximum efficiency throughout the group.
Our award winning partnership approach to contract distribution ensures all parties remain focused on cost control without compromising service levels, meeting and often exceeding client expectations.Delivering cost effective supply chain solutions is a prerequisite for all business units.
Continued investment in training and personal development enables individuals to pursue rewarding and satisfying careers.

TEMPERATURE CONTROLLED TRANSPORT
Turners temperature controlled division is BRC accredited and delivers services of the highest quality 24 hours a day 365 days of the year to a nationwide network of major retail, food service and processing sectors.
The core fleet of over 600 vehicles and 700 trailers operates from four key hubs statically located in East Anglia, Lincolnshire, The Vale of Evesham and Scotland.
All equipment is fitted with the latest technology for temperature monitoring, tracking and achieving the lowest environmental impact.
At Turners we can accommodate all temperature requirements from -25 C to +15 C and are equally able to offer a consolidation service for these temperature ranges at Newmarket and Bicker in Lincolnshire.
Rigid vehicles and trailers are all to ATP (frc) Class C certified specification which covers all European carriage. Twin evaporated trailers fitted with twin load restraint enables product of different temperatures to be safely and securely transported to final destinations whether picked to a pallet, cage or Dolly.
All data is fully archived providing opportunities for KPI, trend monitoring and daily reporting. Proofs of delivery documents are scanned and emailed or accessible on line from the website.
All Turners drivers are fully trained and conversant with temperature controlled deliveries. They understand the importance of air flow circulation, load restraint and security to ensure pristine deliveries on time, every time.
